newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down as IPE gas oil drops from highs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down as IPE gas oil drops from highs.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were traded slightly lower by late afternoon on Friday, on profit taking and as London gas oil came off its intraday highs.
Brokers said March Brent had achieved a strong reversal since hitting $22.00 and some players could be locking in profits.
March was last traded on SIMEX at $23.12 per barrel, down six cents from London's overnight settlement. Just 55 lots had changed hands. Earlier the contract had traded at $23.20, up two cents.
A broker said prices could drift down to $22.75 support after this week's run up as players limit exposure over the weekend.
"It was just a reversal, not a clear trend up," one broker said. He said the rally to $23.25 on Thursday represented a 50-percent retracement after hitting $22.00.
NYMEX crude futures tracked the Brent market, with March on ACCESS dipping two cents to $24.85. Activity was light.
London gas oil opened strongly to $215.25 per tonne, up $3.25 from the previous close, but was last traded up $1.00 at $213.00 on the day.
